assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for deepseek-v4-pro//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep4: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for deepseek-v4-pro//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

routing.reason: no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for deepseek-v4-pro//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep4: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

routing.reason: no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

routing.reason: no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8

assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode

assumptions.Name: cache_record

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for deepseek-v4-pro//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
